title: SeeDream 5.0 Flash
description: ByteDance SeeDream 5.0 Flash — fast, low-cost text-to-image and image editing with multi-reference composition from up to 10 reference images and 1K/2K output, typically in under 20 seconds. Can keep a transparent background when editing a PNG cutout. Billing: a flat 25 credits per image at 1K or 2K; input images are free. No grouped/sequential generation.

background.description: Output background. "transparent" keeps a transparent background when editing: it needs exactly one input image, a PNG that already has transparent pixels (a cutout, sticker or logo), and returns a PNG with an alpha channel. Text-to-image and multi-reference requests must use "opaque".

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate. Write `@handle` to cast a character: a BudgetPixel AI influencer or one of your own ([`GET /v1/characters`](/api-reference/characters/list-characters-you-can-cast)).

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 10) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image. Input images are free.

size.description: Output resolution. Both tiers bill the same 25 credits per image.
